intro: Captain Garran Vimes rates your work as the best Vimes has seen from an amateur. Lady Jaina Proudmoore asked Vimes to keep her apprised of a delicate situation, and Vimes gives you the report to bring to her in Theramore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've done some good work, friend, best I've seen from an amateur.
Lady Proudmoore asked that I keep her apprised of this delicate situation, and I haven't spoken to her for some time now.
I was going to deliver my report to her later, but it seems more fitting that you should be the one to speak with her about it. You can probably answer her questions better than I could.
